definitions: Specialized garments or gear designed to shield the wearer from hazards such as chemicals, heat, sharp objects, or biological agents.
Apparel worn to provide a barrier against injury or contamination in various work environments or activities.
examples: Workers in the chemical plant must wear protective clothing.
Firefighters rely on their protective clothing for safety.
The lab requires full protective clothing for all experiments.
Always use appropriate protective clothing when handling hazardous materials.
